title: A Virgo Environmental Survey Tracing Ionised Gas Emission (VESTIGE). XII. Ionised gas emission in the inner regions of lenticular galaxies
question: What are the ionisation sources, star formation efficiency, dust and gas properties, and evolutionary origins of the ionised gas discs and filaments in the inner regions of massive lenticular galaxies in the Virgo cluster?

recipe.goal: Calibrate, image, and compute moment maps of archival ALMA CO data and derive H2 masses
recipe.method: Recalibrate raw ALMA data in CASA 4.2.0, image with TCLEAN in CASA 5.8 using Briggs weighting (robust 0.5), compute moment maps with threshold masking in IMMOMENT, and convert integrated CO fluxes to molecular gas masses
assumptions: X_CO = 2.3 x 10^20 cm^-2/(K km s^-1) (Strong et al. 1988)

recipe.goal: Reduce VESTIGE narrow-band Halpha+[NII] images, subtract stellar continuum, and extract integrated fluxes
recipe.method: Reduce MegaCam images with Elixir-LSB, subtract stellar continuum using r-band and NGVS g-r colour map, and extract fluxes and sky background in elliptical apertures using 1000 random sky displacements
key_parameters: 1000 random sky displacements; central saturated region masked in NGC 4262, 4459, 4526, 4552

recipe.goal: Extract emission line maps and ratios from MUSE and SOAR spectroscopy to determine gas density, metallicity, and ionisation mechanism
recipe.method: Fit stellar continuum and nebular emission lines with GANDALF using MILES library; map Balmer decrement, [SII]6716/6731 electron density, O/H metallicity (Curti et al. 2017 calibration), and BPT diagnostic diagrams
key_parameters: S/N > 5 for oxygen abundance lines; radial extraction 3.3''-7.5'' (NGC 4429) and 3.3''-7.8'' (NGC 4476) for SOAR
assumptions: Curti et al. (2017) O/H calibration; Osterbrock & Ferland (2006) and Proxauf et al. (2014) for ne from [SII] doublet

recipe.goal: Correct Halpha luminosities for [NII] contamination and dust attenuation, derive SFRs, and characterise individual HII regions
recipe.method: Correct Halpha+[NII] for [NII] and for dust attenuation via Balmer decrement (or A(g) scaling) and Spitzer 24 um emission, convert to SFR, and run HIIPHOT to detect and measure individual HII regions
key_parameters: L(Halpha) >= 10^37 erg s^-1, r_eq(Halpha) >= 50 pc, surface brightness limit Sigma(Halpha) = 3 x 10^-17 erg s^-1 cm^-2
assumptions: [NII]/Halpha = 0.78 when spectroscopy unavailable; Halpha/Hbeta ~ 5 for NGC 4429 and NGC 4476; A(Halpha) = 3.01 x A(g) for NGC 4459 and 4477; Kennicutt (1998a) calibration and Chabrier (2003) IMF

recipe.goal: Measure dust masses from optical A(g) attenuation maps and from UV-to-far-IR CIGALE SED fitting, and compute gas-to-dust ratios
recipe.method: Subtract 2D stellar models from NGVS g-band images to compute A(g) dust masses; fit stellar and IR SEDs with CIGALE to derive total dust masses; compare radial profiles of convolved Balmer decrement and Herschel PACS 100 um in NGC 4526; compute G/D ratios
key_parameters: 10 photometric bands (FUV to K) for stellar SED; 8 IR bands (WISE 22 um, MIPS 24, 70 um, PACS/SPIRE 100, 160, 250, 350, 500 um) for dust SED; 0.4 kpc elliptical annuli for NGC 4526 radial profile
assumptions: Milky Way extinction curve; Q_ext = 2, rho_dust = 3 g cm^-3, a = 0.1 um; Bruzual & Charlot (2003) models, Chabrier (2003) IMF, Draine & Li (2007) dust models; K_100 = 27.15 cm^2 g^-1, T = 22.6 K for NGC 4526; G/D = 80 for estimating H2 mass when CO unavailable

recipe.goal: Analyse the spatially resolved Kennicutt-Schmidt relation at ~100 pc scales using ALMA and VESTIGE data
recipe.method: Convolve ALMA moment 0 and VESTIGE Halpha NB images to matching resolution, rebin to 1.2'' pixels, mask S/N < 5 and central <= 2'' pixels, and compare Sigma_SFR vs Sigma_gas with late-type galaxy relations
key_parameters: matching resolutions: 0.70'' (NGC 4429), 0.86'' (NGC 4459), 0.86'' (NGC 4476), 1.14''x0.76'' (NGC 4526); pixel size 1.2''; S/N >= 5; central <= 2'' masked
assumptions: X_CO = 2.3 x 10^20 cm^-2/(K km s^-1), R_21 = 0.65, R_31 = 0.31, and mean dust attenuation corrections

score_reason: All three ALMA project codes, CASA versions, weighting, and conversion factors are explicitly stated and key numerical outputs (I(CO), M(H2), SFR, M_dust) are tabulated, but low-level imaging/masking parameters, aperture definitions, and proprietary/custom-reduced optical datasets (VESTIGE, NGVS models, SOAR) prevent a full end-to-end reproduction without external files.
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA raw data for NGC 4429, 4459, 4476, and 4526 are public in the ALMA archive with explicit project codes, and the integrated CO fluxes and derived H2 masses in Table 6 provide a clear numeric target for reproducing the ALMA portion of the analysis.
